home.problemSubtitle: The information exists. It is just scattered and hard to read.
home.aiSubtitle: Built so the AI does not make things up.

aiPoints.title: Only registered material
aiPoints.body: It answers only from rights information and organisations that LINKRIGHTS has reviewed and registered.

aiPoints.title: No invented contacts
aiPoints.body: Organisation names and phone numbers come only from our registered list.

aiPoints.title: It says when it does not know
aiPoints.body: With no grounding it will not guess. It tells you who to ask instead.

aiPoints.title: Danger comes first
aiPoints.body: If the situation looks urgent, emergency contacts are shown before any general answer.

ask.title: Ask the AI guide
ask.subtitle: Describe your situation in your own words. Write in any language and the answer comes back in that language.
ask.placeholder: e.g. I worked part-time but I still haven't been paid.
ask.questionHeading: What would you like to ask about?
ask.questionHint: School, part-time work, health, visas and more. Describe what you are going through in your own words.
ask.privacyShort: Do not enter personal details such as your name, phone number, address or passport number.
ask.followUpPlaceholder: What else would you like to know about the answer above?
ask.privacyTitle: Please do not enter personal details
ask.privacyBody: Do not type your name, phone number, address, passport number, alien registration number, visa number or medical records. Describing the situation is enough.
ask.disclaimer: The AI answer is a first guide. Confirm legal, medical and visa decisions with an official organisation.
ask.evidenceNoneTitle: We don't have registered information that fits this exactly yet
ask.evidenceNoneBody: We could not find rights information registered on LINKRIGHTS that fits this situation exactly. So we don't list unconfirmed rights or organisations, and start with things you can do right now.
ask.evidencePossibleNote: Some things are still unclear from a short description, so information that may apply is explained together with its conditions.
ask.relatedTitle: Rights information that may also help, depending on your situation
ask.privacyDetectedBody: Your message seems to include {types}. Describing the situation is enough to get guidance, so we recommend removing this part.
ask.privacyDetectedSubmit: Please check before sending. Remove this part and send, or edit it yourself?
ask.privacyDetectNote: This is a simple check to prevent mistakes, so it cannot find every kind of personal information. Please also make sure you have not written your name or address.

cycle.title: The virtuous cycle LINKRIGHTS wants to build
cycle.subtitle: This is a goal we are still working toward: so that one person's experience can become help for the next.

steps.title: Know my rights
steps.body: Through rights education and rights information, young people learn what rights they have.

steps.title: Find help when needed
steps.body: When something happens, they find where to get help through rights information, AI guidance and organisations.

steps.title: Choose and act for myself
steps.body: Knowing their rights, they choose among the options for themselves and take action.

steps.title: Share experiences
steps.body: Through mentoring and activities, experiences and questions are shared together.

steps.title: Reach the next person better
steps.body: We keep improving rights information with feedback from youth, mentors and organisations, so it reaches the next young person better.

cycle.loopNote: And the cycle starts again, with the next young person learning about their rights.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How LINKRIGHTS handles information, in plain language.

sections.title: There are no accounts
sections.body: LINKRIGHTS has no sign-up and no login, so we do not collect names, emails or phone numbers.

sections.title: AI questions are not stored against a person
sections.body: Your question is sent to the AI service (OpenAI) to produce an answer and is not stored linked to any user. Minimal technical records (time and type of an error) may be kept to fix faults.

sections.title: Please do not enter these details
sections.body: Do not type identifying information such as your name, contact details, address, passport number, alien registration number, visa number or medical records. Describing the situation is enough.

sections.title: No advertising or tracking cookies
sections.body: This site carries no advertising and does not use cookies to track visitors.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The official websites we link to are run by those organisations, and their own privacy policies apply there.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question, email us at the address in the footer.

footer.aboutSite: LINKRIGHTS is a rights information platform for young people with a migrant background.
footer.notAdvice: Information here is general guidance, not legal or medical advice. Confirm decisions with an official organisation.
